en: 2.6 The Chapter on Legal Issues (Adhikaraṇavāra) For a lustful bhikkhunī who consents to bodily contact with a lustful man, among the four kinds of legal issues, which kind of legal issue are these offenses?

For a lustful bhikkhunī who consents to bodily contact with a lustful man, these offenses are, among the four kinds of legal issues, a legal issue arising from an offense (*āpattādhikaraṇa*) ... [and so forth].
For one who eats after having requested curd, among the four kinds of legal issues (*adhikaraṇa*), which legal issue is it?
For one who eats after having requested curd, the offenses are a legal issue arising from an offense (*āpattādhikaraṇa*).
The sixth section on legal issues is finished.
